title: Nature has a rhythm
text: Why do these numbers keep appearing in nature? Meet Fibonacci.

title: One simple rule
text: One, one, two, three, five, eight. Add the last two numbers to get the next.

title: A pattern in plants
text: In many sunflowers, seed spirals can be counted in neighboring Fibonacci numbers. Pinecones often show similar patterns.

title: Room to grow
text: Many plants place new growth near the golden angle: about one hundred thirty seven point five degrees. This spacing reduces repeated alignment.

title: A spiral is not proof
text: But a spiral is not automatically Fibonacci. Shells, storms, and galaxies can form spirals through different growth and physical processes.

title: Look closer
text: Fibonacci is a remarkable pattern in some living systems. Yet life and the cosmos follow many different rules. Look closely. Count. Then ask why.
